name: zc_sun_shadow_seen

tests.name: the sun's light component was found
the same state measured twice gives the same answer

detail.note: THE CONTROL. If shadowing-on and shadowing-restored disagree by as much as the effect being looked for, the run is measuring drift rather than the sun.

tests.name: the sun's shadow is INVISIBLE at night, so the second caster costs the player nothing

detail.note: THE DECISION THIS RUN EXISTS FOR. If the sun's shadow cannot be seen, item 11's second caster is a LATENT defect: real in the actor list, invisible on screen, and not worth spending a locked founder approval to remove -- the documented attempt lifted the whole night by half. If it CAN be seen, the defect is visible and the narrow knob is worth the work. Either way this is the measurement that decides, and nobody had taken it.
